2607.14957.title: Contextualized Early Detection of Online Firestorms: A Sequential LLM-Based Approach
2607.14957.paper_summary: Online firestorms are rapid collective escalations of highly negative user-generated content and may cause substantial reputational and economic damage. Existing detectors usually work with volume signals, sentiment scores, or predefined linguistic features. Such signals are useful, but they capture contextual meaning shifts in evolving discussion threads only indirectly. This paper proposes an LLM-based detection system with two operating modes. The first mode classifies complete Reddit threads retrospectively by combining local chunk-level assessments into a thread-level judgment. The second mode processes threads sequentially and issues early warnings when a sliding window exceeds calibrated thresholds. In this mode, the language model estimates three firestorm indicators: negativity share, escalation level, and contributor count. On a balanced Reddit dataset, the global mode achieves strong classification performance, while the early warning mode reaches high recall and detects escalating threads after only a small number of comments and distinct contributors. The results indicate that LLMs can be used not only for static judgment tasks, but also as repeated estimators in context-aware monitoring of social media discourse.
2607.14957.paper_summary_zh: 在線火災風暴是高度負面用戶生成內容的快速集體升級，可能會造成重大聲譽和經濟損失。現有的檢測器通常依賴於量信號、情感得分或預定的語言特徵。這些信號是有用的，但它們僅間接捕捉到不斷演變的討論串中的上下文意義變化。本文提出了一種基於LLM的檢測系統，具有兩種操作模式。第一種模式通過將局部塊級評估結合為線程級判斷，回顧性地對完整的Reddit討論串進行分類。第二種模式按順序處理討論串，並在滑動窗口超過校準閾值時發出早期警報。在此模式中，語言模型估計三個火災風暴指標：負面比例、升級水平和貢獻者數量。在一個平衡的Reddit數據集中，全球模式實現了強大的分類性能，而早期警報模式在僅有少量評論和不同貢獻者後就能檢測到升級的討論串。結果表明，LLM不僅可以用於靜態判斷任務，還可以作為上下文感知的社交媒體話語監測中的重複估計器。
